input.text: A controller shall comply with section 6502(b)(1)(A) of this title.

_note: A bracketed sub-pinpoint ('(b)', '(1)', '(A)') carries its OWN digits -- '1' -- that are NOT a second section number. Parenthesised groups are stripped before extracting section numbers, so a perfectly in-file citation with a sub-pinpoint is not wrongly classified EXTERNAL.
